placements.heading: Required practical: pure dry salt crystals
placements.purpose: Filter excess insoluble solid, collect the salt solution, then concentrate it in an evaporating basin over a water bath and cool to crystallise.

placements.heading: Required practical: aqueous electrolysis
placements.purpose: An aqueous solution is electrolysed using a low-voltage DC supply and separate inert electrodes: positive anode and negative cathode.
